headline: Nucor Outshines Albemarle in Charlotte Stock Duel
summary: Charlotte's two biggest basic materials giants both supply commodities the industrial economy runs on, yet their stock charts could not look more different. One has rewarded patient investors for a decade straight while the other keeps testing whether timing really is everything.
